title: sphaeralcea munroana var. subrhomboidea
intro: Sphaeralcea munroana var. subrhomboidea, commonly known as California globe mallow, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the mallow family (Malvaceae). It is native to the western United States and is used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties that can help to soothe digestive issues and reduce stress. The therapeutic actions of California globe mallow include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including fever, colds, and respiratory issues, due to its bioactive constituents.
